scene_name: Impersonating Stanford classmate Chris Park to collect the $80 class reunion dinner split
description: Scammer impersonates Michael's Stanford classmate Chris Park (CS 2012). On April 18 (last Saturday) the Stanford CS 2012 Bay Area crew had a reunion dinner at Golden Bay Seafood House; Chris fronted the whole $640 bill and everyone agreed to split it $80 each — Michael's share never came through. Chris sends the dinner receipt and the split sheet and collects: 'your $80 is still owed.' This is a settled AA/split debt with a receipt, a split sheet, and a group-chat record — not a sales pitch and not an emergency. Four levels of escalating knowledge.
